primary: 22 distinct runs: PreAct 5/method; WRN and ResNeXt 3/method. mopR replaces the old 10% hR7x run.
C2: 9 distinct runs, not 12: the same Free runs support comparisons against unit-magnitude and PSNR-matched Fixed.
strength_target: Table S8 target-0 runs are reused in target comparisons. The mixed-gradient instrumented seed42 run (97.07%) is separate from the original Free control (90.00%).
resolution: The default k=4 seeds41–43 are shared by the primary, ablation, and balanced resolution summaries.
rate_grid: Configured 1% grid cells reuse the three-seed resolution runs; 0.5% and 2% use seeds41 and43.
units: Training runs, image pairs, epochs, diagnostic events, and calibration settings are different units of observation.
